units.title: Initialize independent Academy web app and CI
scope: Create independent Academy Next.js app with SDK version pin and environment validation.
Add build, lint, tests, CI, deploy/preview pipeline and feature-flag control.
Define Academy-owned content DB schema and prevent embedding engine secrets.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Build/test/deploy independent application consuming published engine SDK.
verification: Deploy a functional app shell to a preview without copying engine code.
An incompatible engine SDK version fails CI or produces clear degraded state.

units.title: Shared SSO and project portability
scope: Connect OIDC login and user/organization scope to Academy sessions.
Display shared canonical projects and directly open artifacts by engine IDs.
Preserve run history and grants while switching from/to Command Center.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Existing user opens one project in both apps with same artifact IDs and no conversion.
verification: Same project/version IDs open in both products with no import/export.
A revoked membership cannot open old shared project links.

units.title: Academy theme, responsive accessible shell
scope: Design approachable but restrained Academy shell, typography, spacing, navigation and responsive rules.
Apply shared tool renderer with education-specific surface tokens.
Test semantic structure, keyboard focus and reduced-motion baseline.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Warm restrained tokens, keyboard navigation and WCAG baseline are verified.
verification: Mobile and desktop major routes are usable by keyboard.
Switching themes changes presentation but never data or tool behavior.

units.title: Tools directory, search and goal-first onboarding
scope: Create searchable tools catalog grouped by user goals and capability families.
Offer project creation by desired artifact rather than requiring model selection.
Reflect live enabled, unavailable and upcoming statuses from server catalog.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Learner reaches any enabled tool or a blank project with accurate support status.
verification: A novice reaches each enabled editor from a goal-oriented entry.
Unavailable tool/provider cannot deceptively launch a demo job.

units.title: Lesson/slot schema and learning registry
scope: Implement Academy-owned lesson/course/version entities and stable engine UI-slot references.
Define micro-lesson and course schemas, prerequisite and compatibility validation.
Build lesson registry reader with graceful invalid-anchor handling.
units.acceptanceCriteria: All lessons reference stable manifest slots and verified tool-version ranges.
verification: Every instructional attachment resolves to a declared stable tool anchor.
An outdated lesson is flagged rather than silently attached to wrong control.

units.title: Reusable micro-hints and inline learning overlay
scope: Render dismissible contextual help on stable controls using shared slot IDs.
Support hint density preferences, keyboard navigation and low-obstruction placement.
Track explicit user intent without embedding instructional code in engine packages.
units.acceptanceCriteria: At least ten validated anchors open dismissible hints without obscuring editing.
verification: Ten representative interactive anchors show relevant short explanations.
No lesson overlay traps focus or covers core editing action.

units.title: Context tooltips, examples and 30-second lessons
scope: Write and connect task-oriented tooltips, worked examples and compact L0/L1 micro-lessons.
Include accessible text-first and localized-content-ready representations.
Establish editorial accuracy/version review for help examples.
units.acceptanceCriteria: L0/L1 instruction is coherent, keyboard accessible and content-versioned.
verification: A learner completes a real basic action after a short inline lesson.
Incorrect/outdated examples are caught by content fixture checks.

units.title: Scoped AI tutor conversation and content retrieval
scope: Integrate AI tutor scoped to verified current lesson, user permission and consented project artifacts.
Retrieve approved lesson text and actual control/tool events as context, not unrelated user history.
Bound tutor spend, cite lesson references and label uncertainties.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Tutor sees only consented project and verified lesson/tool events.
verification: Tutor answers correct control question without seeing unrelated tenant projects.
Tutor refuses to fabricate completed runs or unsupported model capability.

units.title: Step-by-step guided execution of live tool interfaces
scope: Implement guided step controller observing real engine tool actions and run results.
Use explicit expected events/rubrics to validate each step before progressing.
Store resumable checkpoints and allow user to leave guidance without losing work.
units.acceptanceCriteria: L2 lesson completes only after actual control events or run evidence.
verification: Complete a guided generation and prove actual artifact version created.
A fake click or mocked output cannot earn live-completion badge.

units.title: Interactive project lessons and goal checklists
scope: Build L3 goal-based tutorials with deliverable checklist and workflow preview.
Connect bill/package and another cross-domain example to real editable project outputs.
Support interruption, targeted reteaching and artifact-specific feedback.
units.acceptanceCriteria: L3 bill/film-like project builds editable outputs with checkpoint resume.
verification: Bill/package lesson produces each checked output with preserved lineage.
Pause at a checkpoint, resume, and edit a single result independently.

units.title: Evidence-based learner assessment and feedback
scope: Specify machine-checkable assessment rubrics for artifacts, actions and source evidence.
Generate formative feedback linked to exact artifact versions and instructor review option.
Distinguish AI assessment from verified execution and human certification.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Rubrics cannot pass on the strength of a model assertion without verifiable output.
verification: Submitting no output cannot pass despite optimistic model response.
Changing artifact after grading invalidates or records corresponding evidence version.

units.title: Safe practice fixtures, dry-runs and labeling
scope: Build safe practice fixtures with explicit simulation badges and reproducible sample assets.
Separate estimated/test usage from genuinely paid provider runs and user ledger.
Prevent fixture data from entering paid completion reports as live output.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Practice mode is explicit and never misrepresented as actual paid generation.
verification: Practice demo completes without charging a real provider.
User can distinguish simulated and actual generation at every step.

units.title: Curriculum dependency graph and learner pathfinding
scope: Model prerequisites, competencies, difficulty, lesson dependencies and course sequence.
Suggest learning paths from declared goal, current proficiency and actual assessment results.
Include opt-out from adaptive recommendations and avoid hidden progress claims.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Suggested next lesson follows prerequisites and user-declared goals.
verification: Missing prerequisite blocks false mastery claim while permitting exploration.
Path recalculates when user demonstrates required competency.

units.title: Personal learning progress, privacy and resume
scope: Persist enrollments, learning progress, checkpoint artifacts and consent choices in Academy schema.
Support export/deletion requests and cross-device resume under one identity.
Separate project ownership from educational event analytics.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Private progress persists, is exportable/deletable and survives app transitions.
verification: User resumes an interrupted tutorial on a second device.
Progress deletion is verified without deleting unrelated owned creative work.

units.title: AI-assisted authoring plus human editorial approval
scope: Build AI-assisted lesson/course draft authoring using registered tools, prerequisites and rubrics.
Require human editorial review for factual, provider, rights, plagiarism and accessibility accuracy.
Version approved content and include issue/review history.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Draft course publishing requires peer, factual, rights and accessibility checks.
verification: Unreviewed AI-generated course cannot publish.
Reviewed draft fails publication if its referenced tool anchors no longer exist.

units.title: Versioned course catalog, enrollment and entitlements
scope: Deliver browsable versioned course catalog with outlines, enrollment and entitlements.
Preserve historical lesson versions for ongoing learners and expose migration flags.
Link required model capabilities and estimated compute bundles to course listings.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Purchased course records persist, lesson versions remain compatible or flag issues.
verification: A learner retains access to correct purchased version after update.
Revoked/refunded course entitlement changes access without erasing user work.

units.title: Foundational courses across major tool categories
scope: Author actual foundation modules for writing, research, code and image with hands-on tasks.
Attach formative assessments, source examples, estimated compute and accessible alternatives.
Validate every published practice against current tool capability and provider policy.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Build actual modules in text, research, code and image with assessment artifacts.
verification: Learner completes each of four categories producing real artifacts.
Course task fails honestly when required provider is unavailable.

units.title: Advanced multi-modal capstone course pipeline
scope: Implement L4/L5 capstone from project brief through multimodal workflow and review.
Provide film-pitch or legislative-package coursework with cross-tool dependencies and instructor rubric.
Support artifact portfolios, revision feedback, bounded reruns and final export.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Learner completes one multi-tool project with reproducible rubric evidence.
verification: One complete capstone generates multiple correctly linked artifacts.
A failed trailer shot can be fixed without recreating completed upstream project.

units.title: Paid checkout, refunds and finite course compute bundles
scope: Integrate payment checkout, tax/fee reporting hooks, refund and signed webhook handling.
Sell course entitlements with finite included compute and transactional ledgers.
Reconcile invoice, entitlement, reserved compute and actual provider billable units.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Payments and credits reconcile with invoice/provider records and entitlement tests.
verification: Duplicate payment webhook does not create two enrollments.
Refund revokes entitlement and adjusts unused bundle balances correctly.

units.title: Bounded free tier and contribution-margin subsidy
scope: Define bounded introductory free-tier quotas and anti-abuse controls by identity, device signal and rate limits.
Model subsidy as percentage of positive course contribution margin with fixed monthly global cap.
Enforce graceful exhaustion messaging and optional purchased/BYOK routes where allowed.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Hard subsidy cap is enforced; no unlimited paid-provider operation on free grants.
verification: Thousands of concurrent free requests cannot exceed subsidy ceiling.
An exhausted user retains access to free static lessons and owned outputs.

units.title: Course quality analytics, instructor moderation and support
scope: Instrument consent-aware lesson outcomes, verified completion, dropout and cost-to-completion metrics.
Build moderation/review queue for instructor feedback and broken lesson anchors.
Expose non-sensitive operations/support dashboard with outcome and financial reconciliation.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Consent-preserving dropout/learning outcomes and review queue are visible.
verification: Analytics reports exclude opted-out or private project contents.
Support can diagnose a failed lesson using IDs without reading unrelated work.

units.title: A11y/localization/performance across tutorial overlays
scope: Audit overlays and course player for screen readers, keyboard-only flows and reduced motion.
Support translation keys and locale-safe course content with text alternatives for media.
Test responsive and low-bandwidth progression with persistent checkpoints.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Screen reader, keyboard, low-bandwidth, reduced-motion and localization QA pass.
verification: All critical L0-L5 flows pass WCAG 2.2 AA-oriented audit.
A slow connection does not lose lesson steps or submitted artifacts.

units.title: Live end-to-end acceptance, privacy review and deployment
scope: Deploy Academy app to authorized domain with release identity and rollback.
Exercise free enrollment, checkout/refunds, live AI tutorial, capstone and cross-app project switching.
Record security/privacy/a11y and operations evidence with real model-cost reconciliation.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Paid/free sign-ups, live provider lesson and cross-app project moves verified.
verification: End-to-end test operates against deployed Academy, Command Center and engine SHAs.
Failed readiness or simulated provider output blocks production acceptance.
